objective: Standard statement: confirm tickets A and C by exact computation: on every census class up to 10 points (160 untwisted, 2492 with one twisted incidence) the system is not colourable, has one amplitude at every line, the same as its transpose at every point, and equal to the product of its brace amplitudes; lambda(0) from the law's corner relation at every corner line of every three-fold space up to 22 points equals (-1)^(n-1) times that product; the planar glue factor equals the arborescence numbers on omnitruncations of maps (= spanning trees) and on the glue of hypermaps (= hypertrees); trisums of prisms along a square face are not colourable with a Pfaffian signing and have one amplitude, which depends on the gluing and not only on the pieces' amplitudes; spaces with trisum glue obey the law with that amplitude. Nearest known result: tickets A and C. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by exhaustive computation: all 2652 census classes have one amplitude, equal to the transpose's and to the product of brace amplitudes; the law exact at every corner up to 22 points; planar glue = spanning trees / hypertrees; trisum amplitudes depend on the gluing
title: The amplitude by computation
